audio_role: Voice counts 'rock paper scissors shoot' then a short percussive beat track. The plate reveal lands on the 'shoot' beat, and the three food close-ups cut on the following beats with no sizzle or talking.
can_make: We can make shots 2-4 from what we have: start each 4 s AI clip from the real menu photo of the pasta and the real menu photo of the salad, add AI-drawn hands/forearms in long sleeves holding the bowl steady underneath, and cut bowl-to-bowl-to-both-together on the beat. We cannot convincingly make shot 1 as real: the fast fist pumps and finger throws of rock-paper-scissors with two synced hands will warp and lose fingers, so we would replace live play with a still setup of two fists and a hard cut to the plates already in frame.
core: Two people settle what to show with rock-paper-scissors, so the game delay makes the reveal of two plates the payoff.
dish: creamy chicken pasta and tomato-mozzarella salad
fits: Pairs of two finished plates that look different from each other: pasta vs salad, fried vs fresh, pizza vs salad, burger vs salad, two bowls or two appetizers served at once.
hook: Two fists hover over a dark restaurant table about to play rock-paper-scissors.
needs_camera: Only a real camera in the real room gives the live game: two real hands pumping and throwing signs in sync, real skin and sleeve motion, real table reflection, real out-of-focus lights and dining room behind, and real gloss and depth when hot pasta and fresh salad are lifted and tilted together.
people: hands only, nobody else. Two forearms enter from left and right edge over a table: left in white pleated sleeve, right in magenta long sleeve. They pump fists, throw scissors signs, then each hand lifts and holds one white bowl toward camera.

shots.action: two hands play rock-paper-scissors then lift two plated bowls up into frame
left hand holds the pasta bowl steady in close-up
right hand holds the tomato-mozzarella bowl steady in close-up
both hands hold both bowls side by side tilted toward lens

why_it_works: Three seconds of hands playing makes the viewer wait, then the camera goes close on sauce-coated pasta with chopped herbs and on sliced tomato with white mozzarella, green basil and dark glaze. Held close and still under bright light the textures and colors are readable: creamy, red, green, white.
